latest_release.name: plugin/agentanalytics v0.1.0
latest_release.body:
The first release of the BigQuery Agent Analytics plugin for ADK Go. It logs every agent run to a BigQuery table, so you can query and dashboard agent behavior with SQL: invocations, model requests and responses, tool calls, state changes, agent transfers and human-in-the-loop requests.

The table schema, event type names and analytics views match adk-python's BigQuery Agent Analytics plugin, so Go and Python agents can write to the same table and be queried together.

## Install

```bash
go get google.golang.org/adk/plugin/agentanalytics@v0.1.0
```

Requires `google.golang.org/adk/v2` v2.0.0 or later.

## Quick start

```go
analytics, err := agentanalytics.NewBigQueryAgentAnalyticsPlugin(ctx, "my-project", "agent_analytics", "agent_events")
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
defer analytics.Close() // flushes queued rows to BigQuery

r, err := runner.New(runner.Config{
	AppName:        "my-app",
	Agent:          myAgent,
	SessionService: session.InMemoryService(),
	PluginConfig:   runner.PluginConfig{Plugins: []*plugin.Plugin{analytics}},
})
```

Call `Close` before the process exits, so that rows still in the queue are written.

## What's included

- **Ready to query out of the box.** The plugin creates the events table if it is missing, adds new columns to an existing table, and creates 25 per-event views such as `v_llm_request` and `v_tool_completed`.
- **Batched, non-blocking writes** through the BigQuery Storage Write API, 100 rows or 1 second per batch by default. Batches over 8 MiB are split so that a single large batch is not rejected as a whole.
- **Redaction on by default.** Values under keys like `api_key`, `password` and `token`, credentials in URLs, and `Authorization`, `Bearer` and `Basic` credentials are replaced with `[REDACTED]`. Text values longer than 512,000 characters are truncated unless `CaptureFullMessageContent` is set.
- **Control over what is logged:** event allow and deny lists, a payload column deny list, a `ContentFormatter` hook to transform or redact payloads before they are written, custom tags, and an allow list for `CustomMetadata` keys.
- **Cloud Storage offload** (optional). Set `GCSBucketName` to store large text and binary parts in a bucket and keep a reference in the row.
- **Exactly-once delivery** (optional). `ExactlyOnceDelivery` writes through a committed stream with explicit offsets, so retries do not write rows twice.
- **Drop counters.** `DropStats` reports rows lost to a full queue, failed writes or shutdown.
- **OpenTelemetry correlation** (optional). `EnableOTelCorrelation` adds the current trace and span IDs to each row.

See the [package documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/adk/plugin/agentanalytics) for every option.

## Before you use it

- **This is a pre-1.0 release.** The exported API may still change before v1.0.0, including helpers such as `BatchProcessor`, `FormatContentParts`, `SmartTruncate` and `ArrowSchema`. The path to v1.0.0 is tracked in #2014.
- **Register it before plugins that replace results.** ADK stops at the first plugin callback that returns a replacement event, model response or tool result, so the analytics plugin does not see what an earlier plugin replaced.
- **Known differences from adk-python** are listed in #2046 and #2047. For example, when a callback recovers a failed tool call, Go logs `TOOL_ERROR` followed by `TOOL_COMPLETED`, while Python logs only `TOOL_ERROR`.

# Agent Development Kit (ADK) for Go [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Go Doc](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go%20Package-Doc-blue.svg)](https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/adk/v2) [![Nightly Check](https://github.com/google/adk-go/actions/workflows/nightly.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/google/adk-go/actions/workflows/nightly.yml) [![r/agentdevelopmentkit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Reddit-r%2Fagentdevelopmentkit-FF4500?style=flat&logo=reddit&logoColor=white)](https://www.reddit.com/r/agentdevelopmentkit/) [![View Code Wiki](https://www.gstatic.com/_/boq-sdlc-agents-ui/_/r/YUi5dj2UWvE.svg)](https://codewiki.google/github.com/google/adk-go)

An open-source, code-first Go toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control.

Important Links: Docs & Samples & Python ADK & Java ADK & Kotlin ADK & TypeScript ADK & ADK Web.

Agent Development Kit (ADK) is a flexible and modular framework that applies software development principles to AI agent creation. It is designed to simplify building, deploying, and orchestrating agent workflows, from simple tasks to complex systems. While optimized for Gemini, ADK is model-agnostic, deployment-agnostic, and compatible with other frameworks. This Go version of ADK is ideal for developers building cloud-native agent applications, leveraging Go's strengths in concurrency and performance. --- ## ✨ Key Features * **Idiomatic Go:** Designed to feel natural and leverage the power of Go. * **Rich Tool Ecosystem:** Utilize pre-built tools, custom functions, or integrate existing tools to give agents diverse capabilities. * **Code-First Development:** Define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Go for ultimate flexibility, testability, and versioning. * **Modular Multi-Agent Systems:** Design scalable applications by composing multiple specialized agents. * **Deploy Anywhere:** Easily containerize and deploy agents, with strong support for cloud-native environments like Google Cloud Run. ## 🚀 Installation ADK Go requires Go 1.26.10 or later (see [go.mod](go.mod)). To add ADK Go to your project, run: ```bash go get google.golang.org/adk/v2 ``` ## 📖 Docs for AI coding agents [adk.dev/llms.txt](https://adk.dev/llms.txt) is a machine-readable index of the ADK documentation, and [adk.dev/llms-full.txt](https://adk.dev/llms-full.txt) is the same documentation as a single file. Both are generated from [adk-docs](https://github.com/google/adk-docs/) and include the Go API reference and samples, so you can point a coding agent at either one for context: ```text Plan and implement an agent that reviews customer issues and generates a report. Use the ADK Go framework, referring to https://adk.dev/llms-full.txt for sample code. ``` To work on this repository rather than build with it, see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the Apache 2.0 License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. The exception is internal/httprr - see its [LICENSE file](internal/httprr/LICENSE).
